description: Configuration for the ML residual correction on top of the first-order physics drift baseline (src/models/iceberg_ml_residual.py). The model predicts the EAST and NORTH displacement residual over a 24 h step: observed displacement minus physics-predicted displacement, in metres, in the local geographic tangent plane. The physics baseline remains the reference; this layer only adds a correction to it.

target.basis: local geographic east/north tangent plane, the same one src/models/iceberg_physics.py integrates in
target.note: the target is a displacement over exactly one day, so it is not transferable to a step of another length without an assumption this project has not made

features_deliberately_omitted.size_major_km: present on only 10.4% of the moved 24 h rows; omitted rather than imputed, per the project rule that a missing source value is never fabricated

split.method: chronological by start date, never randomised
split.snap_note: cut points are taken at the 60th and 80th percentile of the MOVED rows and then snapped to date boundaries, so every row sharing a start date lands in the same split and no same-day pair straddles a boundary

estimator.name: HistGradientBoostingRegressor
estimator.selection_metric: mean endpoint error in km of the corrected prediction on the VALIDATION split
estimator.grid_rationale: three modest configurations, not a search. With 893 training rows a larger grid would be selecting on noise.

known_limitations: Every moved 24 h row in this dataset comes from a single sensor (ASCAT). Whatever is learned is an ASCAT-specific correction and should not be assumed to transfer to NIC, QuikSCAT or other position sources.

Longitude is used raw and is discontinuous at the antimeridian. With ~900 training rows a sin/cos encoding was not added, but a model that splits on longitude near 180 degrees is splitting on an artefact.
893 training rows is a small sample for a gradient-boosted model. The fixed three-point grid and the leaf-size floor are there to limit how much of that sample the model can memorise.
The residual target is a 24 h displacement and is not rescaled to other horizons.
not_claimed: No improvement is asserted here. The evaluation reports measured test metrics for the constant-velocity baseline, the physics baseline and the corrected model side by side, and the numbers stand on their own.
